_doc: The drawing arm's own figures: its reach, its stack of parts, and what its error budget assumes until the bench measures it. Examples chapter 12 explains each.
name: arm

sheet_w.rule: An A5 sheet's long side, across the arm's front

sheet_h.rule: An A5 sheet's short side, away from the arm

near.rule: From the shoulder's axis to the sheet's near edge: past the base and the pen holder's width

upper.rule: Shoulder to elbow: with the forearm, the shortest pair that keeps the far corner at 88% of full stretch (the speed check's slowest point) and folds to the near edge

fore.rule: Elbow to pen: as short as the reach allows, because the elbow's error swings through it

play_shoulder.rule: The shoulder's play at its output with the bias spring taking up the gear backlash
play_shoulder.source: A target, not a measurement: bench test 14 in projects/benchmarks/MEASURE.md settles it

play_elbow.rule: The elbow's play, the same gearbox and bias
play_elbow.source: A target, not a measurement: bench test 14

twist_shoulder.rule: The shoulder's gear train twisting under the pen's drag and the bias

twist_elbow.rule: The elbow's gear train twisting, the same

deflection.rule: The links bending sideways at the pen under its drag, from beam formulas
deflection.source: 0.3 N of drag on the forearm and holder as cantilevers: bench test 17 measures the whole budget at once

drag.rule: A pen's drag on paper, about, pulled sideways at the tip
drag.source: A hand guess from a pen on a spring scale: measure yours

shoulder_torque.rule: What the shoulder must do at the task's speed and accel: the pen's drag at 240 mm, the arm's inertia and the bias
shoulder_torque.source: Drag 0.07 N m + inertia about 0.03 N m + the rubber band's bias 0.1 N m

elbow_torque.rule: What the elbow must do: the pen's drag at 110 mm, the forearm's inertia and the bias
elbow_torque.source: Drag 0.03 N m + inertia 0.01 N m + the rubber band's bias 0.04 N m

foot.source: Stiff enough for four M5 screws

room.rule: Air between the shoulder motor's back and the base plate

face.rule: The shoulder motor's mounting face above the bench: the base's height

plate.rule: The shoulder housing's plate: enough for M3 screws into a NEMA 17 (1.5 × their size)

ring_gap.rule: Between the fixed ring and the output ring

flange.rule: The output ring's flange: thick enough for four M3 screws to bite

output_top.value: face + plate + gear + ring_gap + gear + flange
output_top.rule: Top of the shoulder's output flange above the bench

disc.rule: The spindle's disc, on the flange

bridge_gap.rule: Between the spindle's disc and the bridge above it

bridge.rule: The bridge's thickness: the 5 mm bearing and a 2 mm ledge

bridge_low.rule: The bridge's underside above the bench

arm_gap.rule: Between the bridge's top and the upper arm's underside

arm.rule: The upper arm's thickness, a plate over the elbow too: about 1.7 mm of sag under its load at 8 mm thick, 0.5 mm at 12
arm.source: The cantilever formula in EXAMPLES.md chapter 12

switch_pitch.rule: Between the endstop's two screw holes
switch_pitch.source: endstop-10t85 in @rulecad/rules: the set has words among its figures, so an object can't read it through uses

boss.rule: The forearm's boss, so the bar passes under the elbow's clips

elbow_flange.value: bridge_low + bridge + arm_gap - gear - ring_gap - gear - flange
elbow_flange.rule: The elbow output flange's underside, where the forearm bolts on: the upper arm's underside less the elbow's stack

fore_low.rule: The forearm bar's underside above the bench

fore_mid.rule: The holder's bolts, level with the middle of the forearm

press.rule: How far below the paper the pen tip sits at rest, so the leaf spring presses it down
press.source: Sets the pen force through the guide's stiffness
